verdict: Yes, if you have a sourcing story. Dorji from Darjeeling pitched flavoured teas on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal from three sharks. Tea is India's everyday drink, and buyers pay a premium for origin, flavour and freshness.
angle: Darjeeling, Assam and Nilgiri teas carry strong origin appeal in India and abroad. Flavoured blends, gift boxes and cold brews reach younger buyers. Tea is light and keeps well, which suits online selling. Buy direct from gardens to keep quality and margins.

faq_extra.q: Where can I source tea for my own brand?
faq_extra.a: Tea gardens and auction centres in Kolkata, Guwahati, Siliguri and Coonoor sell to small brands. Buying direct from a garden lets you tell an origin story, which is what premium buyers pay for.
